fitting.score_units: relative log-odds, not raw game scores
fitting.active_hours_proxy: number of 30-minute relative-start bins containing successful user actions / 2; not actual play time
fitting.unsampled_series: shrink toward player global fit; no evidence of series-specific ability

Ku.scenario_adjustment: User requires unmatched series-3 specialist; elite series-2 fitted maximum + 0.9. Not identified by six series-3 pairs.

G.assumption: Unobserved: user-specified elite potential; strongest fitted series strength + 1.25 log-odds; draw bias assumed
